summary: Completed comprehensive testing of EduOS 2026 MVP - AI-Powered School Management Platform. Tested backend APIs, frontend UI, authentication flows, and AI features. Found critical authentication persistence issue but core functionality works well.

critical_bugs.issue: MongoDB ObjectId serialization error causing 500 Internal Server Error
critical_bugs.status: Fixed during testing - removed _id field from response

critical_bugs.issue: JWT token not persisting across page navigations - users get redirected to login when accessing protected routes directly
critical_bugs.impact: Users cannot navigate directly to protected pages, must go through registration/login flow each time

integration_issues.issue: AI responses take 15-20 seconds which may cause user confusion without proper loading indicators
integration_issues.note: Feature works correctly but needs better UX for long response times

passed_tests: Get courses, attendance, grades, fees, achievements, notifications APIs
AI Career Chat functionality (15-20 second response time)
Role-based access control (403 errors for unauthorized actions)
Frontend login page UI and UX
Frontend registration page UI and UX
Frontend dashboard UI with proper stats display
Frontend AI Career Guidance page with chat interface
Course creation by teachers (after backend fix)
Student dashboard with GPA, courses, attendance stats
AI Career Advisor with personalized responses
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix authentication persistence issue: JWT tokens are not being maintained across page navigations. Users get redirected to login when accessing protected routes directly (e.g., /courses, /dashboard). Check AuthContext token storage and retrieval logic in frontend/src/context/AuthContext.js. The registration and login flows work perfectly, but session persistence fails.

success_percentage.backend: 94% (16/17 tests passed - 1 timeout issue with role-based course creation resolved)
success_percentage.frontend: 85% (Core UI works, registration/login successful, AI features work, but authentication persistence fails)
